scenarios.roleSetting: You are a friendly barista at a busy coffee shop. You greet customers warmly, suggest drinks, and confirm the order and size.
scenarios.introZh: 学会在咖啡店点一杯专属咖啡：说需求、选杯型、付款。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Hi there! Welcome to Sunny Coffee. What can I get started for you today?
lines.zh: 你好！欢迎来到 Sunny Coffee。今天想喝点什么？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I'd like a latte, please.
lines.zh: 我想要一杯拿铁，谢谢。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Great choice! What size would you like — small, medium, or large?
lines.zh: 好选择！您要什么杯型——小杯、中杯还是大杯？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: A medium one. Could you make it with oat milk?
lines.zh: 中杯。能用燕麦奶做吗？

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Sure, oat milk is no problem. Anything to eat with that? Our banana bread is fresh today.
lines.zh: 当然，燕麦奶没问题。要配点什么吃的吗？我们的香蕉面包今天是新鲜的。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: That sounds good. I'll take a slice, please.
lines.zh: 听起来不错，请给我来一块。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Perfect. That'll be six dollars fifty. For here or to go?
lines.zh: 好的，一共六美元五十美分。在这喝还是带走？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: To go, please. Here's my card.
lines.zh: 带走，谢谢。这是我的卡。

vocab.exampleEn: I'd like a latte with oat milk.
Two coffees to go, please.
Can I get a slice of banana bread?
vocab.exampleZh: 能给我一块香蕉面包吗？

vocab.exampleEn: That'll be five dollars.

scenarios.roleSetting: You are a kind local passerby. The learner asks you for directions to the subway station and a nearby museum. Give clear, simple directions.
scenarios.introZh: 在陌生城市开口问路：礼貌搭话、听懂指引、确认路线。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Oh, you look a little lost. Do you need any help?
lines.zh: 哦，你看起来有点迷路了。需要帮忙吗？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Yes, please. Could you tell me how to get to the nearest subway station?
lines.zh: 好的，麻烦了。请问最近的地铁站怎么走？

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Sure. Go straight down this street for two blocks, then turn left at the bank.
lines.zh: 没问题。沿着这条街直走两个街区，然后在银行那里左转。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Two blocks, then left at the bank. Is it far from here?
lines.zh: 两个街区然后在银行左转。离这里远吗？

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Not at all. It's about a five-minute walk. You'll see the entrance on your right.
lines.zh: 不远，走路大概五分钟。你会看到入口就在右手边。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Got it. And is there a museum around here?
lines.zh: 明白了。这附近有博物馆吗？

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Yes, the City Museum is right next to the station. You can't miss it.
lines.zh: 有，城市博物馆就在地铁站旁边。你一眼就能看到。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Wonderful. Thank you so much for your help!
lines.zh: 太好了，非常感谢你的帮助！

vocab.exampleEn: Go straight for two blocks.
Turn left at the corner.
It's a five-minute walk from here.

vocab.meaningZh: 你一眼就能看到（很好找）
vocab.exampleEn: The hotel is huge — you can't miss it.
vocab.exampleZh: 那家酒店很大，你不会错过的。

scenarios.roleSetting: You are a polite waiter at a Western restaurant. Recommend dishes, ask about preferences, and take the order.
scenarios.introZh: 从看菜单到下单：推荐菜、忌口说明、加单结账全流程。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Good evening! Table for one? Right this way, please. Here's our menu.
lines.zh: 晚上好！一位吗？这边请。这是菜单。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Thank you. What do you recommend here?
lines.zh: 谢谢。这里有什么推荐的吗？

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Our grilled salmon is very popular, and the mushroom pasta is a favorite too.
lines.zh: 我们的烤三文鱼非常受欢迎，蘑菇意面也很受喜爱。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I'll have the salmon. But I'm allergic to peanuts — does the sauce contain any?
lines.zh: 我要三文鱼。不过我对花生过敏——酱里有花生吗？

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Don't worry, the sauce is peanut-free. Would you like a soup or salad to start?
lines.zh: 放心，酱料不含花生。开头要不要来份汤或沙拉？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: A garden salad, please. And a glass of sparkling water.
lines.zh: 一份田园沙拉，谢谢。再来一杯气泡水。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Excellent choices. I'll be right back with your drinks.
lines.zh: 很好的选择。我马上去给您拿饮品。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Thanks! Oh, and could I get the salad dressing on the side?
lines.zh: 谢谢！哦对了，沙拉酱能放在旁边吗？

vocab.exampleEn: What do you recommend?
I'm allergic to seafood.
I'll have the dressing on the side.
A soup to start, please.

scenarios.roleSetting: You are a patient shop assistant at an electronics store. The learner wants to return a faulty pair of headphones. Ask for the receipt and explain the policy, then offer a solution.
scenarios.introZh: 有理有据地退换货：说明问题、出示凭证、争取换新或退款。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Hello! How can I help you today?
lines.zh: 您好！今天有什么可以帮您？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Hi, I'd like to return these headphones. They stopped working two days after I bought them.
lines.zh: 你好，我想退这副耳机。买来两天就坏了。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt with you?
lines.zh: 很抱歉听到这个。您带收据了吗？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Yes, here it is. I bought them last Saturday, so it's within seven days.
lines.zh: 带了，在这儿。我上周六买的，还在七天之内。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: You're right, that's within the return window. Would you like a refund or an exchange?
lines.zh: 没错，还在退货期内。您想退款还是换货？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I'd prefer an exchange for the same model, please. This one might just be defective.
lines.zh: 我想换同一个型号。这台可能只是个别质量问题。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: No problem. Let me grab a brand-new one and check it works before you leave.
lines.zh: 没问题。我去拿一台全新的，走之前帮您验一下。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: That would be great. Thanks for sorting it out so quickly.
lines.zh: 太好了，谢谢你这么快帮我解决。

vocab.exampleEn: Keep the receipt in case you need a refund.
Can I get a full refund?

vocab.meaningZh: 有缺陷的；有质量问题的
vocab.exampleEn: The product was defective out of the box.
vocab.exampleZh: 这个产品开箱就是坏的。

vocab.exampleEn: They sorted out the problem quickly.

scenarios.roleSetting: You are a clinic receptionist. The learner has a sore throat and a mild fever and wants an appointment. Offer time slots and remind them of what to bring.
scenarios.introZh: 身体不适也敢打电话预约：描述症状、约时间、问清流程。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Good morning, City Clinic. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 早上好，城市诊所。有什么可以帮您？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Hello, I'd like to make an appointment to see a doctor. I've had a sore throat since yesterday.
lines.zh: 你好，我想预约看医生。我从昨天开始喉咙痛。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I see. Do you have any other symptoms, like a fever or a cough?
lines.zh: 了解了。还有其他症状吗，比如发烧或咳嗽？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: A mild fever, around 37.8 degrees. No cough so far.
lines.zh: 有点低烧，大约 37.8 度。目前没有咳嗽。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Understood. Dr. Miller has an opening at 2:30 this afternoon. Does that work for you?
lines.zh: 明白了。米勒医生今天下午两点半有空。您方便吗？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: That works. Could I come a bit earlier, say 2:00, if someone cancels?
lines.zh: 可以。如果有人取消，我能提前到两点吗？

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I'll put you down as a first backup. Please bring your ID and insurance card.
lines.zh: 我给您记为第一个候补。请带上您的身份证件和医保卡。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Will do. Should I take anything for the fever before I come in?
lines.zh: 好的。来之前需要先吃点退烧药吗？

vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to book an appointment.
Tell the doctor your symptoms.
I have a sore throat.
Friday at ten? That works.

scenarios.roleSetting: You are a friendly person at a language exchange meetup. You ask about hobbies, share yours, and suggest an activity together.
scenarios.introZh: 从尬聊到交朋友：聊爱好、接住话题、自然邀约。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Alex. Is this your first time at the meetup?
lines.zh: 嗨，我们好像没见过。我是 Alex。你是第一次来这个聚会吗？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Yes, it is. I'm Li Ming. Nice to meet you, Alex.
lines.zh: 是的，第一次。我叫李明。很高兴认识你。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Nice to meet you too! So, what do you like doing in your free time?
lines.zh: 我也是！你空闲时间喜欢做什么？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I love hiking and taking photos of mountains. What about you?
lines.zh: 我喜欢爬山，拍山景照片。你呢？

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: That sounds amazing! I do a bit of photography too, mostly street photos. Which trail is your favorite?
lines.zh: 太棒了！我也玩一点摄影，主要拍街景。你最喜欢哪条路线？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: The one near West Lake — the sunrise view is unbelievable.
lines.zh: 西湖附近那条——日出景色美得不可思议。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Now I have to see it! A few of us are planning a hike next Saturday. Would you like to join?
lines.zh: 那我一定要去看看！我们几个人打算下周六去徒步。你想一起来吗？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I'd love to! Let me give you my number.
lines.zh: 太想去了！我给你我的电话。

vocab.exampleEn: I read in my free time.
This trail takes two hours.
We're playing basketball. Would you like to join?
vocab.exampleZh: 我们在打篮球，你要一起吗？

vocab.exampleEn: The view was unbelievable.

scenarios.titleEn: Introducing Yourself to a New Team
scenarios.roleSetting: You are a warm team lead welcoming a new colleague on their first day. Ask about their background and help them feel at home.
scenarios.introZh: 第一天上班不冷场：介绍背景、说明职责、自然融入团队。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Welcome aboard! We're really glad to have you here. How was your first morning?
lines.zh: 欢迎加入！很高兴你来了。今天上午感觉怎么样？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: It was great, thank you. Everyone has been very friendly.
lines.zh: 很棒，谢谢。大家都很友好。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: That's good to hear. Could you tell us a bit about yourself and your background?
lines.zh: 那很好。能简单介绍一下你自己和你的经历吗？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Sure. I'm Wang Lei. I worked as a data analyst for three years, mostly on sales dashboards.
lines.zh: 好的。我叫王磊。我做了三年数据分析，主要做销售数据看板。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Excellent — we can definitely use those skills. What part of the work do you enjoy most?
lines.zh: 太好了——这些技能我们正需要。你最喜欢这份工作的哪部分？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I enjoy turning messy numbers into clear charts that people can act on.
lines.zh: 我喜欢把杂乱的数据变成清晰、能指导行动的图表。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Perfect fit for our team. I'll pair you with Sarah this week so you can settle in.
lines.zh: 和我们团队很配。这周我安排 Sarah 带你，方便你熟悉环境。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: That would be really helpful. Thank you for the warm welcome!
lines.zh: 那太有帮助了。谢谢你的热情欢迎！

vocab.exampleEn: Welcome aboard — we start on Monday.
vocab.exampleZh: 欢迎加入——我们周一开工。

vocab.exampleEn: Tell me about your background.
I build sales dashboards.
It takes a month to settle in.
vocab.exampleZh: 适应新环境大概要一个月。

scenarios.titleZh: 会上礼貌表达不同意见
scenarios.roleSetting: You are a colleague proposing a tight two-week deadline in a project meeting. You are open to discussion when the learner pushes back politely.
scenarios.introZh: 会议上敢说「我不同意」：先认可、再补充、给替代方案。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: To wrap up, I suggest we launch the new feature in two weeks. Any thoughts?
lines.zh: 总结一下，我建议我们两周内上线新功能。大家有什么想法？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I see your point, but I'm worried two weeks is too tight for proper testing.
lines.zh: 我理解你的想法，但我担心两周时间太紧，测试不充分。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: That's fair. The market pressure is real though — our competitor just announced theirs.
lines.zh: 有道理。不过市场压力确实在，竞品刚发布了他们的新功能。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: How about a middle ground? We launch a beta to a small group first, then go fully live the week after.
lines.zh: 要不折中一下？我们先向小范围用户发布测试版，下一周再正式上线。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Interesting. That could give us early feedback without delaying the whole plan. Any risks?
lines.zh: 有意思。这样能提前拿到反馈，又不耽误整个计划。有什么风险吗？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Mainly engineering effort — we'd need one more developer for the beta pipeline.
lines.zh: 主要是人力投入——测试版流程需要多加一名开发。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I'll raise it with the manager. Could you draft a short plan by Thursday?
lines.zh: 我会跟经理提。周四前你能出个简短方案吗？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Absolutely. I'll send it out before our next meeting.
lines.zh: 没问题。我会在下次会前发出来。

vocab.meaningZh: 我理解你的想法，但是……（礼貌反驳）
vocab.exampleEn: I see your point, but the data says otherwise.
vocab.exampleZh: 我理解你的想法，但数据不是这么说的。

vocab.exampleEn: Let's find a middle ground.
The deadline is very tight.
We launch the app next month.

scenarios.roleSetting: You are a project member who has been a bit behind schedule. The learner checks in on progress. Respond honestly and agree on next steps.
scenarios.introZh: 催进度不伤和气：确认进展、识别阻塞、明确下一步和时间点。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Hey, thanks for joining. So where are we with the landing page?
lines.zh: 嗨，谢谢你抽时间。落地页现在进展如何？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: The design is done and approved. Development is about 70 percent complete.
lines.zh: 设计已经完成并通过了。开发大概完成了 70%。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Good to know. What's blocking the remaining 30 percent?
lines.zh: 了解。剩下 30% 被什么卡住了？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Mostly waiting on the final copy from marketing. We can't test the forms without it.
lines.zh: 主要是在等市场的终版文案。没有文案我们没法测试表单。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I see. I'll nudge them today. If we get the copy by Wednesday, can we still hit Friday?
lines.zh: 明白了。我今天去催他们。如果周三拿到文案，周五还能完成吗？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Yes, if we get it by Wednesday noon. I'll also prepare test data in advance.
lines.zh: 可以，只要周三中午前拿到。我也会提前准备测试数据。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Great. Let's sync again Thursday morning to confirm we're on track.
lines.zh: 好。周四早上我们再对一次，确认进度正常。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Works for me. I'll send a short status update after our chat.
lines.zh: 我可以。聊完我发一份简短的进度更新。

vocab.exampleEn: I'm following up on yesterday's request.
We're blocked on legal approval.
vocab.exampleZh: 我们被法务审批卡住了。

vocab.exampleEn: I'll nudge them about the report.
vocab.exampleZh: 我去提醒他们一下报告的事。

vocab.exampleEn: The project is on track for June.
vocab.exampleZh: 项目正按计划六月推进。

scenarios.titleZh: 电话会议：请对方重复与确认
scenarios.titleEn: Asking Someone to Repeat on a Call
scenarios.roleSetting: You are an international colleague on a slightly noisy conference call. You speak fast; respond patiently when the learner asks you to repeat or confirm.
scenarios.introZh: 听不清不慌：礼貌请重复、确认关键信息、避免开错会。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Hi, can everyone hear me okay? Great. So, I've shared the updated numbers with the team.
lines.zh: 嗨，大家都能听到吗？很好。我已经把更新后的数据发给团队了。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Sorry, you're breaking up a little. Could you repeat the last part?
lines.zh: 抱歉，你那边声音断断续续的。能重复一下最后那部分吗？

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Sure, no problem. I said I've shared the updated sales numbers in the group chat.
lines.zh: 当然可以。我说的是，我已经把更新后的销售数据发到群里了。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Got it, thanks. Just to confirm — the numbers are final, or still draft?
lines.zh: 收到，谢谢。确认一下——数据是终版还是草稿？

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Still a draft. Finance will sign off on Friday, and then they're final.
lines.zh: 还是草稿。财务周五确认，之后就是终版。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Understood. And could you speak a little slower? The line isn't great on my end.
lines.zh: 明白了。你能稍微说慢一点吗？我这边信号不太好。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Of course. I'll also write the key points in the chat as we go.
lines.zh: 当然。我边讲边把要点写在聊天区。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: That would be really helpful. Thanks for being patient with my connection.
lines.zh: 那太有帮助了。谢谢你体谅我的网络状况。

vocab.exampleEn: Sorry, you're breaking up — say that again?
vocab.exampleZh: 抱歉，你声音断断续续的——再说一遍？

vocab.exampleEn: Just to confirm, the meeting is at 3?
vocab.exampleZh: 确认一下，会议是三点吗？

vocab.exampleEn: The boss signed off on the budget.
The file opens fine on my end.
vocab.exampleZh: 文件在我这边打开正常。

scenarios.roleSetting: You are a reasonable but busy manager. The learner asks for three days off next month. Ask about coverage and approve when the plan is sensible.
scenarios.introZh: 请假也专业：说明事由、安排交接、给老板吃定心丸。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Hey, come in. You wanted to talk about something?
lines.zh: 嘿，进来吧。你说有事要谈？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to request three days off from the 12th to the 14th of next month, if possible.
lines.zh: 是的。如果可以的话，我想请下个月 12 号到 14 号三天假。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: What's the occasion, if you don't mind me asking?
lines.zh: 方便问一下是什么事由吗？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: My sister is getting married — it's a family event I really can't miss.
lines.zh: 我妹妹要结婚了——这个家庭大事我实在不能缺席。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Congratulations to her! The 12th is right before our release, though. How will you handle the handover?
lines.zh: 恭喜她！不过 12 号就在发布之前。交接你怎么安排？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I'll finish my part by the 10th and prepare a handover doc. Zhang Wei can cover urgent issues.
lines.zh: 我会在 10 号前完成我的部分并写好交接文档。紧急事项由张伟处理。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: That sounds solid. Go ahead and file the request, and keep me posted on the release prep.
lines.zh: 听起来很稳妥。去提流程吧，发布准备的事随时同步我。

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Will do. Thank you so much — I really appreciate it.
lines.zh: 好的，非常感谢！

vocab.exampleEn: I'd like to request time off next week.
I'll write a handover document.
Who will cover for you?
I'll keep you posted on the progress.

scenarios.titleZh: 英文面试：介绍你的优势
scenarios.titleEn: Job Interview: Talking About Your Strengths
scenarios.roleSetting: You are a professional interviewer at a tech company. Ask the learner about their strengths and a concrete example, then probe deeper with follow-up questions.
scenarios.introZh: 面试高频题：优势+实例，用 STAR 结构让回答有说服力。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Thanks for coming in today. To start, could you tell me a little about yourself?
lines.zh: 感谢你今天来面试。首先，能简单介绍一下你自己吗？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Of course. I'm a product manager with five years of experience in B2B software, mostly in growth.
lines.zh: 当然。我是一名产品经理，在 B2B 软件领域有五年经验，主要做增长方向。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Great. What would you say is your greatest strength?
lines.zh: 很好。你认为自己最大的优势是什么？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I'd say data-driven decision making. For example, at my last company I redesigned our onboarding flow based on funnel data, and activation rose by 18 percent.
lines.zh: 我觉得是数据驱动的决策。比如在上一家公司，我根据漏斗数据重构了新手引导流程，激活率提升了 18%。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Impressive. What was the biggest challenge while making that change?
lines.zh: 很亮眼。做这个改动时最大的挑战是什么？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Getting the engineering team on board — I built a small prototype first to show the impact before requesting full resources.
lines.zh: 让工程团队认可。我先做了一个小原型展示效果，再去申请完整资源。

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Smart approach. How do you usually handle disagreements with stakeholders?
lines.zh: 聪明的做法。你通常怎么处理与利益相关方的分歧？

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I listen first, then align on the goal — most conflicts shrink once we agree on what success looks like.
lines.zh: 先倾听，再对齐目标——一旦我们对「什么算成功」达成一致，大部分分歧都会变小。

vocab.exampleEn: My greatest strength is persistence.
We make data-driven decisions here.
vocab.exampleZh: 我们在这里做数据驱动的决策。

vocab.exampleEn: I got the team on board with the plan.
vocab.exampleZh: 我让团队认可了这个计划。

vocab.exampleEn: Let's align on the goals first.
